title: Hardness Surveillance EMP Program (HSEP) for ICBM. The contractor shall furnish all equipment required to perform HSEP testing to include High altitude burs pulser that is approved and certified for nuclear safety by the Government IAW PWS.
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND > AIR FORCE NUCLEAR WEAPON CENTER > STRATEGIC SYSTEMS-AFNWC > FA8207  AFNWC PZBC
description:
Hardness Surveillance EMP Program (HSEP) for ICBM. The contractor shall furnish all equipment required to perform HSEP testing to include High altitude burs pulser that is approved and certified for nuclear safety by the Government IAW PWS. 

 Hardness Surveillance Electromagnetic Pulse (HSEP) Program which includes engineering services, testing services, and technical support to test, surveil and ensure the resilience of the MMIII missile systems against electromagnetic pulse attacks.
